summary.zh: 课表、成绩、考试、公告与请假
summary.en: Timetable, grades, exams, notices, and leave requests

description.zh: 查询课表、成绩、学分、考试、公告、空闲教室与请假记录；账号密码只在插件页使用
description.en:
Query timetable, grades, credits, exams, notices, free classrooms, and leave records with the Node.js academic affairs CLI inside the Linux runtime.
Sign-in and credentials are handled on the plugin page, and the CLI installs automatically on first use.
